scope: Provider-free analysis of retained DEV020 compact journal results and DEV014-derived selection facts.

threshold_recovery.contract: A token qualifies when retained lowest observed MC is at least the stated percentage below the qualified opening MC. Above-opening/multiple counts require lowest_observed_timestamp < observed_peak_timestamp; they establish an ordered low before the selected observed peak, not a verified absolute ATH or a candle-by-candle recovery path.

interpretation: The retained observations support a strong negative association at the 70% threshold: only 15/62 later exceeded opening, 8/62 reached 2x, and 3/62 reached 5x before the selected observed peak. This is not a causal, controller, manipulation, or complete-history conclusion. Sparse windows and unobserved lifecycle gaps remain explicit.
storage: Analysis is compact and payload-free. Raw provider responses are absent; no writer or file can reach 500 MB in this work.
